name: @fozy-labs/statechart
description: Statechart tooling for @fozy-labs/rx-toolkit: the mermaid .mmd converter and the StatechartViz React component
author: Vladimir Panev <vova6255@gmail.com>

scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/converter && npm run build -w packages/viz
scripts.ts-check: npm run build -w packages/converter && npm run ts-check -w packages/converter && npm run ts-check -w packages/viz
scripts.test: npm run build -w packages/converter && npm run test -w packages/converter && npm run test -w packages/viz
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build -w packages/converter && npm run test:e2e -w packages/viz
scripts.check:all: npm run build && npm run check:all -w packages/converter && npm run check:all -w packages/viz
